subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw add a per-spawn silent-parent completion mode on top of current main’s parent-first handoff, and should that choice also become global/per-agent configuration persisted across restarts?
rationale: Current main now solves the core parent-wakeup problem, leaving a narrower policy decision about suppressing external delivery and exposing durable configuration; implementation correctness cannot choose that permanent contract.

options.title: Narrow to per-spawn silent mode
options.body: Preserve current main’s parent-first default and expose only an explicit per-call option for parent processing without external delivery.

options.title: Approve the full policy surface
options.body: Retain per-call, per-agent, and global configuration plus persistence after explicitly accepting precedence, upgrade, and fail-closed semantics.

options.title: Close as unnecessary
options.body: Treat current main’s requester-session handoff and `sessions_yield` workflow as sufficient and close the branch without another completion policy.

recommendation.title: Narrow to per-spawn silent mode
recommendation.body: Preserve current main’s parent-first default and expose only an explicit per-call option for parent processing without external delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent history covers the tool entry point, requester handoff, and subagent lifecycle boundaries involved in this product choice.
